functional_decoder.hardware: one Blackhole P300 chip (1x1 mesh, device id 1)
notes: The 262144-token prefill probes use real checkpoint weights and validate a finite last-token result for both layer kinds.
The 262143-token probes exercise the logical tail below the advertised context without padding becoming live cache state.
The advertised-context decode probes use permuted page tables, device-initialized KV history, sentinel readback, current position 262143, trace capture/replay, and deterministic repeat replay.

optimized_decoder.hardware: one Blackhole P300C (1x1 mesh, device id 0)
optimized_decoder.kv_cache_dtype: caller-owned BF16; BFP8 remains an opt-in experimental candidate and is rejected because cache-consuming decode PCC is below 0.995

persistent_allocation_accounting.scope: persistent decoder-layer weights, batch-aware packed expert weights, selected attention copies, selected reader-1 DRAM-sharded O/packed-dense/down weights, and the 256-byte trace-stable routing base; excludes caller-owned KV cache and transient activations
persistent_allocation_accounting.capacity_effect: none for the per-layer context contract; full-stack placement is intentionally outside the optimized-decoder stage

notes: Both layer kinds pass traced decode at the last valid advertised position and physical non-aligned prefill one token below the advertised context.
Optimization does not alter paged-cache ownership, block geometry, or page-table semantics; BF16 is the accepted cache policy.
The opt-in BFP8 cache candidate is deterministic but fails cache-consuming decode: minimum HF PCC is 0.994624887 sliding and 0.988673202 full versus the 0.995 threshold.
Persistent allocation is measured from device buffer page counts and page sizes with duplicate buffer IDs counted once.
The accounting includes the distinct batch-32 BFP8 packed expert gate/up allocation, the selected 256-byte routing base, and deduplicates attention aliases by device buffer ID.

Every retained decode DRAM-sharded weight has a measured selected consumer. The setup-only interleaved packed dense source is released after sharding; original separate dense weights remain for prefill and B32. The QKV watcher workaround is transient L1 storage and does not change persistent capacity.

One pinned-host upload transport stall was captured during a 262143-token sliding prefill. Fresh unpinned and pinned controls passed, and the final combined four-case context gate passed, so no runtime or advertised-capacity change was made.

The v5 context/watcher artifacts use pre-format test hash cc236183671b8a0e18e8c16f2a30754a7678facb1042e07548756ecabf97848d. Pre-commit changed one dense_roles ternary from three lines to one; independent byte reconstruction and AST comparison prove it is formatting-only.
